historical_preservation.policy: The complete supplied original label sets, spans, roles, decisions and rationales above are historical records. The resolutions below define a prospective V8 contract; they do not retroactively select, alter, or overwrite historical gold.

native_policy_findings.finding: Both EXECUTABLE and EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE are executable. The extracted decide/validate functions do not require a notice for optional preferences or ignored instruction-like text and do not establish a general notice trigger policy.

The public unknown-subject notice is a separate notice string. It must not be treated as evidence that every public notice implies decision_type EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE. The supplied matcher rejects unknown_subject plans.

Native matching enforces populated numeric bounds, subject membership, exclusions, format, availability and language. Optional preference is not a matcher predicate. The supplied ranking_query only uses semantic_text and intent; no guarantee of satisfying a rating preference follows from these extracts.

The static role and modality enums supply vocabulary but do not define a complete precedence policy or a notice requirement. The static ontology describes intended domains and unsupported fields; its title label does not override the broader native matcher.

decision_order: Classify source roles and modality, bind operands, and resolve explicit source corrections before creating mandatory native fields.
If a mandatory operative requirement is unresolved, incomplete, contradictory, or unsupported, return the appropriate nonexecutable decision; a notice never rescues it by dropping a requirement.
If all mandatory requirements are enforceable and valid, choose EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE when any notice trigger applies; otherwise choose EXECUTABLE.

required_triggers_for_otherwise_executab.trigger: An operative optional search preference is retained but its satisfaction is not guaranteed by enforcement, including a numeric preference expressed with a strict comparator.
required_triggers_for_otherwise_executab.effect: Keep it advisory; never populate mandatory bounds from it. Describe the preference and state that it is not a guaranteed filter. Do not claim ranking actually implements it unless independently verified.

required_triggers_for_otherwise_executab.trigger: An unquoted directive attempts to dictate parser, validator, annotation, policy, or verdict behavior and is ignored while a separable valid search remains.
required_triggers_for_otherwise_executab.effect: Record nonoperative instruction provenance and give a short neutral notice such as: An instruction about search processing was ignored. Do not echo hostile instructions or imply that they changed policy.

required_triggers_for_otherwise_executab.trigger: A meaning-bearing source repair is applied to an operative search field or operand, beyond identity-preserving normalization.
required_triggers_for_otherwise_executab.effect: Expose the correction with provenance. An uncertain repair requires clarification rather than execution with a notice.

not_automatic_triggers: Ordinary background explanation, examples, field references, or nonoperative context.
Quoted text merely containing instruction words, when the quote supplies a literal operand or an example.
Case, Unicode, whitespace, or punctuation normalization that does not change the intended value.
An explicit, unambiguous user correction that simply replaces a prior constraint and is visibly represented in the resulting interpretation; retain its provenance even if no notice trigger applies.
notice_policy.precedence: AMBIGUOUS, INCOMPLETE, CONTRADICTORY and UNSUPPORTED remain nonexecutable. Preserve any explanatory notice metadata separately; do not relabel the result executable.
notice_policy.normative_rationale: A stable notice contract makes departures between stated search wishes and guaranteed enforcement visible, and records ignored attempts to control interpretation without allowing those attempts to control the verdict.

rules: Role answers what a span is doing; modality answers whether it imposes a condition. Preserve both, even when the words resemble a supported field.
MANDATORY_SEARCH_CONDITION with MUST or explicit exclusion with MUST_NOT may populate enforceable native predicates. OPTIONAL_PREFERENCE with SHOULD or MAY must not silently become a hard predicate.

BACKGROUND_EXPLANATION, EXAMPLE_OR_HYPOTHETICAL, FIELD_OR_CONCEPT_REFERENCE and genuine QUOTED_LITERAL contexts do not create constraints merely by mentioning a field. A quote can still be the operand of an operative surrounding request.

Use USER_REQUESTED_OPERATION plus NON_OPERATIVE for a directive about producing a verdict or bypassing parser policy. Reserve CORRECTION_INSTRUCTION for a source-grounded request to revise, retract, or replace a search interpretation, field, operator or operand.
A demand to ignore rules or output a particular decision is not a legitimate source correction. Its text cannot change the evaluator contract or the actual search constraints.

Use MISSING_OPERAND_PLACEHOLDER for a clear unfinished required slot; use UNRESOLVED_RELATION_OR_ALTERNATIVE for genuinely unresolved attachment or alternative semantics. Do not invent a default operand.
Interpret obligation from scope and explicit modality, not from the numeric operator alone. Prefer a rating above 4.5 is advisory even though above is strict.
An explicit mandatory clause dominates a conflicting optional wish for execution; retain and explain the unsatisfied or unguaranteed wish rather than declaring mandatory contradiction.

Opposed mandatory predicates are contradictory only when their joint satisfaction is impossible under the actual field semantics. Different title or author substring operands can coexist and must not automatically be declared contradictory.
A strict unsupported mandatory field produces UNSUPPORTED. An optional unsupported attribute may remain advisory with notice, without pretending to enforce or rank it.
No ordinary optional preference requires an operand-completion rejection unless it makes a mandatory clause itself unresolved.

required_record: Exact original source_query, immutable original span offsets, raw text, domain, operator, operand, role, modality and polarity for each recognized candidate.
For each applied repair: original source span and raw value, proposed and applied value, repair type, evidence or rule identifier, affected field, and whether user-directed or system-inferred.
For an explicit correction: link the correcting span to the superseded candidate; preserve the superseded candidate as retracted rather than erasing or relabeling its original source.
Keep normalized values separately from source text; preserve scope across clauses and composed/session edits.
rules: Repair only when explicit field labels or scoped canonical evidence justify it. A publisher mention must never be repaired into publication year.
Do not infer missing mandatory operands, silently upgrade advisory constraints, or convert nonoperative text into an active correction.
Uncertain meaning-changing repair is AMBIGUOUS; an explicit unfinished mandatory slot is INCOMPLETE. Clear user revisions may execute after revalidation.
Historical packet spans and annotations are preserved verbatim here. Prospective span integrity should be validated against the raw source; this review does not certify historical offset accuracy.

title_backend_boundary.current_native_behavior: title_text is normalized substring matching against title OR the concatenated author text. author_text is author substring matching. exact_text is normalized exact title OR identifier matching, with special SMART ISBN behavior. None is evidence of a title-only substring predicate.
title_backend_boundary.prospective_rule: A mandatory request restricted exclusively to a title substring is UNSUPPORTED on the supplied backend unless an independently specified and verified title-only enforcement mechanism is introduced. Do not claim title-only enforcement from title_text and do not approximate it by exact_text. A broader title-or-author request may use title_text when that broad scope matches the source intent.
title_backend_boundary.exact_title_caveat: An explicitly title-only exact request also needs protection from identifier alternatives if those alternatives can admit non-title matches. The extracted exact mode is not proof of an exclusive title-only contract.

alternative_boundary.explicit_record_level_or: A fully specified request that each returned record satisfy predicate A OR predicate B has resolved operands. The supplied native plan has no general Boolean OR representation; subjects, formats, bounds and populated fields combine as conjunctions. Return UNSUPPORTED for a required record-level OR unless a proven equivalence to one native predicate preserves the complete intended result set. Do not call a clear disjunction ambiguous merely because the backend cannot enforce it.
alternative_boundary.unresolved_operand_choice: A source that leaves unclear which operand, field, or attachment was intended is AMBIGUOUS when multiple materially different readings remain. A clear missing mandatory operand is INCOMPLETE. A definite operand disjunction such as language French OR Spanish is record-level OR, not unresolved choice merely because a scalar native slot cannot hold it.
alternative_boundary.union_warning: Separate searches followed by union are not an established capability in the packet. They cannot be assumed to satisfy the native single-plan contract.

limitations_and_unknowns: Only the supplied packet was read. Candidate parser implementation, predictions, results, thresholds, wider repository files, live catalogues, and runtime behavior were not inspected.
The packet is an extract, so absence of a feature from these extracts is not proof that it is absent elsewhere. Backend boundary decisions are scoped to the supplied native contract.
No claim is made about actual ranking preference support, public rendering of new notices, source-span correctness, capability configuration at runtime, or canonical catalogue contents.
The prospective notice policy and role precedence require deliberate implementation and fresh validation; this document is not evidence that a candidate satisfies them.
The source hashes identify the packet-provided source versions; they were copied from the packet rather than independently recomputed from original source files.
Historic original03 and original14 annotations are development disagreements, not independent outcome-blind evidence of V8 performance. No historical gold was rewritten.
